Journey.description: Journey record (departure, transit, arrival) - API output

value.description: Answer value - true/false. Null to remove question answer

Check.description: Checklist item requirement: agent check (eg "check: 2 blank pages")

requirements.description: Embedded requirements as a list (... and ... and ...)
Embedded requirements as a list (... or ... or ...)

FieldCompare.description: Checklist item requirement: compare field value ({field} {operator} {value}, eg expiryDate >= 2025-10-25)

value.description: Value of the field to compare with - type depends on field

FieldIn.description: Checklist item requirement: field value IN list ({field} in [{values}], eg docSubType in [DIPLOMATIC,SERVICE])

FieldNotIn.description: Checklist item requirement: field value NOT IN list ({field} not in [{values}], eg docSubType not in [B1,B2,B1/B2])

ChecklistItemType.description: Checklist item type, eg RESIDENCE_PERMIT/USA which represents USA Green Card

item_territory.description: Item type territory, might be null

is_relevant.description: Whether question is relevant for this passenger, according to current answers to all questions

question_title.description: Declaration title (localised) - formed in either positive or negative form ('I am' or 'I am not'), depending on declaration

sample_image.description: Question sample image (eg US Green Card specimen) with a title

HaveDocumentQuestion.description: A Yes/No question (boolean), manifested through a positive statement of 'I do have {document type}' format

is_relevant.description: Whether question is relevant for this passenger, according to current answers to all questions

sample_image.description: Question sample image (eg US Green Card specimen) with a title

country.description: Document country code (iso alpha-3) - can be EURO

PickFromListQuestion.description: A question with options to choose from, requires single answer (option id)

is_relevant.description: Whether question is relevant for this passenger, according to current answers to all questions

answer.description: Question answer (Option id), if was provided

sample_image.description: Question sample image with a title

QuestionSampleImage.description: Question sample image with a name to form expressions like 'Sample of {title}'

url.description: Image URL for a sample image to go with the question

name.example: Since 01/01/2011, I have visited the following countries:

OnwardTicket.description: Manually entered return or onward ticket

AllowedDocument.description: Describes a document which can be used to resolve checklist item

document_format.description: Document format - to represent in UI

description.example: Verification of your US Green Card is required to travel

sides_configuration.description: Whether document has one or multiple sides (or files, ie PDF)

sides_expectation.description: Whether one or multiple sides (or files, ie PDF) are requested from passenger

multipax_resolution_supported.description: If true, document of this type can be applied to multiple pax sessions with a single apply (ie using multipax-apply-document/file)

country.description: Document country code (iso alpha-3) - can be EURO

expect_long_processing.description: Whether to expect long processing on the backend - allows to show user a warning

page_index_to_process.description: Which page of the document is relevant - pass to /apply

AllowedDocumentsSet.description: A set of documents with which this checklist item can be resolved

force_document_type_required.description: When true, it is required to provide exactly 1 value for `expected_document_types` when calling apply-document/file endpoint - ie user must choose document type they are uploading

allowed_documents.description: List of documents that can resolve a checklist item

IdMismatches.description: A record of mismatches to booking for document applied

given_name.description: Given names mismatch - a pair of (expected, actual); or null if no mismatch on the field

surname.description: Last name mismatch - a pair of (expected, actual); or null if no mismatch on the field

full_name.description: Full name mismatch (for relevant documents, eg Indian E-Visa) - a pair of (expected, actual); or null if no mismatch on the field

number.description: Document number mismatch - a pair of (expected, actual); or null if no mismatch on the field

birthdate.description: Birthdate mismatch - a pair of (expected, actual); or null if no mismatch on the field

sex.description: Sex mismatch - a pair of (expected, actual); or null if no mismatch on the field

nationality.description: Nationality mismatch - a pair of (expected, actual); or null if no mismatch on the field

NoItemsToApplyDocumentTo.description: Apply file: Found no items in checklist to apply document provided

ExpiryDateGteMismatch.description: Rules mismatch: expiry date greater than or equal to

field.description: Name of the mismatched document field

SignalsMismatches.description: A record of mismatches to Zamna Signals for document applied

TravelDocumentRequired.description: Apply file: Passport have to be provided first

Checklist.description: Comprises checklist statuses, questions/answers and checklist items

has_nationality_question.description: True if nationality affects rules - require from passenger, unless `nationality` is not null (was provided already)

has_birthdate_question.description: True if birthdate affects rules - require from passenger, unless `birthdate` is not null (was provided already)

questions.description: List of relevant questions to form the checklist, need to answer all via setAnswers endpoint

resolution_status.description: Checklist resolution status (READY_TO_FLY, ENTRY_NOT_ALLOWED, ACTION_REQUIRED, UNKNOWN or NOT_ELIGIBLE)

items.description: Checklist items to resolve for passenger and their status, shown once all relevant questions are answered

allowed_travel_documents_set.description: All possible documents to satisfy travel document requirement

DocumentRequirement.description: Document requirement with status and acceptable documents (and methods) to resolve it

short_description.example: You need to pay the Non-Resident Fee (DNR)

requirements.description: Any relevant requirements to present to passenger (eg hours to the onward flight for TICKET checklist item type)

allowed_documents_set.description: A set of documents with which this checklist item can be resolved

is_travel_document.description: Whether item is Travel Document requirement

InfoItem.description: Info item - can't be resolved manually

short_description.example: You need to pay the Non-Resident Fee (DNR)

requirements.description: Any relevant requirements to present to passenger (eg hours to the onward flight for TICKET checklist item type)

Pax.description: Passenger basic data (first name, last name, birthdate)

first_name.description: Given names, should be provided if last_name is null

last_name.description: Last name, should be provided if first_name is null

consented.description: Consent response when provided (true: consented, false: didn't consent), null otherwise

pax.description: Passenger basic data (first name, last name, birthdate)

TravelDocument.description: Travel document structure for manual input using /apply-document/travel-document

document_type.description: Type of travel document, see checklist.possible_travel_documents for allowed types for this journey

sub_type.description: Provided document sub type (eg DIPLOMATIC for passport)

BarcodeToDocMismatch.description: Doc recognition error: Barcode data to document mismatch

DocumentTypeNotSupported.description: Doc recognition error: file type not supported

FileTooLarge.description: Doc recognition error: file is too large

FileTypesNotSupported.description: Doc recognition error: file type not supported

MrzToVizMismatch.description: Doc recognition error: MRZ to VIZ mismatch

MrzVerificationError.description: Doc recognition error: MRZ verification failed

NoBarcodeScannedError.description: Doc recognition error: barcode was not present

NoMrzSideScannedError.description: Doc recognition error: mrz document side wasn't provided

NotAllSidesScannedError.description: Doc recognition error: not all required document sides were provided

RecognizedDocumentKindMismatch.description: Doc recognition error: wrong document type

ApplyManualDocumentRequest.description: Request to provide manually entered non-travel document data to resolve checklist item(s)

updated_pax_session.description: If success, updated Pax session, null otherwise

ApplyRecognisedDocumentRequest.description: Request to provide scanned or uploaded images/files to resolve checklist item(s)

method.description: Provision method - should be either `SCAN` or `UPLOAD`

is_travel_document.description: Whether document applied is travel document - should match DocumentRequirement.is_travel_document from Checklist item

additional_pax_ids.description: List of additional pax session ids to apply this document to (apart from main pax session id)

ApplyTravelDocumentRequest.description: Request to provide manually input travel document data to try resolve checklist item(s). When `checklist_item_id` is provided, travel document data applies directly to checklist item by its id. Otherwise, travel document data is applied to all checklist items with `TRAVEL_DOCUMENT` type.

ignore_mistakes.description: Whether to ignore potential data mismatches and accept travel document data provided (unless mismatch to booking data). It will be added to DCS, but not verified until scanned/uploaded

successfully_verified.description: Whether travel document was verified, if false - travel document would require additional scan or upload to be verified

updated_pax_session.description: If success, updated Pax session, null otherwise

SetAnswersRequest.description: Request to set nationality, birthdate, answers to questions and confirm/refute declarations

confirm_declarations.description: List of declaration ids to confirm

refute_declarations.description: List of declaration ids to refute

SetConsentRequest.description: Request to set consent response for MultiPax session

pax_check_token.description: Session token to authenticate to other API endpoints

StartWithBookingIdAndSurnameRequest.description: Request to login with booking identifier and surname, relies on ReCaptcha to prevent robots from using the service

StartWithBookingIdAndSurnameResponse.description: Response to login with booking identifier and surname

pax_check_token.description: Session token to authenticate to other API endpoints

return_url.description: URL to where navigate passenger to

parameters.description: URL to redirect to with auth token as query param
